turns.patient_opening: Hi. I’m 9 years old. I have heavy pain at the top of my head and also pain in my left temple—about 7 out of 10. I also have a sore throat and a clear runny nose/congestion, and someone around me had similar symptoms in the last two weeks.

turns.doctor_question: What color is the rash (for example: red, pink, pale, dark, or yellow)? If there isn’t a rash, you can say “absent.”
Do you currently have a cough? (Yes or no)
Have any of your family members (like a parent, sibling, or child) ever been diagnosed with cluster headaches?
turns.patient_answer: No—I don’t know any family member diagnosed with cluster headaches.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swollen or painful lymph nodes—such as lumps in your neck, under your arms, or in your groin?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed any lumps or swollen, painful nodes.

turns.doctor_question: Have you started any new blood thinners by mouth recently—such as apixaban (Eliquis), rivaroxaban (Xarelto), dabigatran (Pradaxa), or edoxaban (Savaysa)?
turns.patient_answer: No. I haven’t started any blood thinners.

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have a fever—either that you feel (hot/flushed/chills) or that you’ve measured with a thermometer?
turns.patient_answer: I don’t know for sure. I haven’t measured my temperature, and I don’t feel like I have a fever right now.

turns.doctor_question: Are you feeling nauseous right now, or do you feel like you might vomit? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: No, I don’t feel nauseous and I don’t feel like I’m going to vomit.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had diarrhea or an increase in how often you’re having bowel movements recently?
turns.patient_answer: No. I haven’t had diarrhea or more bowel movements than usual.
